nodes.summary: The $\mathbb{C}$-algebra isomorphism from complex Laurent polynomials whose exponents are vectors $e \in \mathbb{Z}^1$ (functions $\{0\} \to \mathbb{Z}$) to complex Laurent polynomials $\mathbb{C}[T, T^{-1}]$ in one variable, induced by the additive isomorphism $\mathbb{Z}^1 \cong \mathbb{Z}$, $e \mapsto e(0)$. Writing $X^{e}$ for the monomial with exponent vector $e$, it sends $c\,X^{e}$ to $c\,T^{e(0)}$.
nodes.title: Identification of one-variable Laurent polynomials

nodes.summary: The additive isomorphism from $\mathbb{Z}^1$, the group of functions $\{0\} \to \mathbb{Z}$ under pointwise addition, to $\mathbb{Z}$ that sends a function $e$ to its value $e(0)$.
nodes.title: Integer vectors of length one

nodes.summary: For a complex Laurent polynomial $F$ in $m$ variables, the logarithmic Mahler measure of $F$ is the real number $(2\pi)^{-m} \int_{[0, 2\pi]^m} \log |F(e^{i\theta_1}, \dots, e^{i\theta_m})| \, d\theta$, the integral taken with respect to Lebesgue measure.
nodes.title: Logarithmic Mahler measure

nodes.summary: For a function $f \colon \mathbb{R}^m \to \mathbb{R}$, the normalized box integral of $f$ is $(2\pi)^{-m} \int_{[0, 2\pi]^m} f(x) \, dx$, the integral taken with respect to Lebesgue measure (and equal to $0$ when $f$ is not integrable on the box).
nodes.title: Normalized box integral

nodes.summary: For an angle vector $\theta \in \mathbb{R}^n$ and an exponent vector $e \in \mathbb{Z}^n$, the real phase of $e$ at $\theta$ is $\sum_{j} e_j \theta_j$.
nodes.title: Phase of an exponent vector

nodes.summary: For an angle vector $\theta \in \mathbb{R}^n$, the torus character $e \mapsto \exp\bigl(i \sum_{j} e_j \theta_j\bigr)$, viewed as a map from the additive group $\mathbb{Z}^n$ written multiplicatively to the multiplicative monoid of $\mathbb{C}$, is a monoid homomorphism: it sends $0$ to $1$ and sums to products.
nodes.title: Torus character as a monoid homomorphism

nodes.summary: For an angle vector $\theta \in \mathbb{R}^n$, the torus character at $\theta$ sends an exponent vector $e \in \mathbb{Z}^n$ to $\exp\bigl(i \sum_{j} e_j \theta_j\bigr) \in \mathbb{C}$.
nodes.title: Torus character

nodes.summary: For an angle vector $\theta \in \mathbb{R}^n$, evaluation at the point $(\exp(i\theta_1), \dots, \exp(i\theta_n))$ of the unit torus is the $\mathbb{C}$-algebra homomorphism from complex Laurent polynomials in $n$ variables to $\mathbb{C}$ that, writing $X^e$ for the monomial with exponent vector $e \in \mathbb{Z}^n$, sends $\sum_e c_e X^e$ to $\sum_e c_e \exp\bigl(i \sum_{j} e_j \theta_j\bigr)$.
nodes.title: Evaluation on the unit torus

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
